title: Commandos 3: Destination Berlin
notes: Vault reads your save games (the Output folder in the game folder) and never touches the game.
Save a game once in each mission you reach. The campaigns can be played in any order.

testGuide.title: Start a campaign
testGuide.detail: Start any campaign mission and save the game once.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Last save" should show the campaign name, and that campaign's first achievement should pop.
